record_keys.catalog: challenge_id (TEXT), with id as identical compatibility alias

joins.relationship: nullable optional self-join; parent may lie outside collected sample

time.caveat: Displayed dates/times are not UTC and must not be localized using collection_timezone. Earliest/latest message spans are not continuous observation windows. Two November 4 rows precede the November 7 event.

categories.definition: An invitation to collaborate; it does not establish actual team membership.
An explicit request for assistance or resources. Message presence does not establish whether the issue was later resolved.
An explicit request for a leaderboard or leaderboard update.
A request about registration, scheduling, submission access or other participation logistics; no organizer role is inferred.
Readable message content outside the specific categories; unverified numerical claims remain text claims, not measured participation.
An explicit self-report in response to a participation prompt. Pseudonymous reported team labels are scoped to that channel collection; neither membership nor entry is verified.
A self-reported challenge goal or current progress; completion and team membership are not verified.
A question or explanation about challenge rules or deliverable requirements; author authority is not implied.
A request for other participants to share scores. The question itself does not verify scores or request an official leaderboard.
Brief social or conversational content without a specific request, progress claim or concrete strategy signal in this coding.
A statement about an approach to trying the challenge; effectiveness is not verified.
A visible image message whose content is not classified; no image-content inference is made.

category_interpretation: Exactly one category per message. Rule clarification includes questions, answers and explanations; coded interpretations are not verified emotional states, outcomes, or unresolved requests.

snapshots.label: Initial Rev sample · Nov 7
snapshots.coverage_note: Ten distinct messages from a bounded visible channel sample. Neither full channel history nor continuous time coverage was established. Exact capture time was not recorded.

snapshots.label: Rev sample reread · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: The same ten-message visible sample was read again. Two message reaction counts were inspected. Navigation to the other challenge contents was blocked by the UI tool; no additional channel messages were acquired. Exact capture time was not recorded.

snapshots.label: Dashboard Royale sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Nine loaded message items were read in the native Chrome Discord interface. The channel-start marker was visible, but complete history, continuous interval coverage and thread contents were not established. One message predates the event; displayed timestamps span November 4–7. A message claims knowledge of eight other teams, but this is an unverified statement, not an observed team count.

snapshots.label: Build-A-Dataset sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Eleven message items were read after scrolling to a visible channel-start marker. The latest loaded item was dated November 7 at 12:37. No complete-history or thread census is claimed. Most discussion concerns external learning or data resources, not difficulty or progress in this challenge.

snapshots.label: House Edge late-message sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Ten latest loaded message items were read while earlier history was still loading. The sample contains banter, scoring jokes, and unverified exaggerated claims; it does not establish model performance, actual scores, winning chances or participant ability. No full channel or thread coverage is claimed.

snapshots.label: House Edge earlier-message sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Twenty additional earlier message items were read. No channel-start marker or complete history was established. Numerical scores are unverified self-reports or banter, not leaderboard measurements. Strategy and submission comments are attributed statements, not verified benchmarks or official rules.

snapshots.label: Heads Up sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Thirty loaded message items were read, spanning displayed November 7–8. No channel-start marker, full-history coverage or thread census was established. Registration, judging and submission advice is attributed to message authors whose roles remain unverified; it is not treated as authoritative event policy.

snapshots.label: Databricks sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Ten loaded message items were read. No channel-start marker, complete history or thread census was checked. Media contents remain uninspected. Setup advice and workshop references are attributed statements from authors whose roles are not verified.

snapshots.label: H-E-B late-message sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Ten latest loaded message items were read. Six contain team labels in replies to a visible quoted participation prompt, whose original message ID was not loaded. Those six posts reference four anonymized reported labels within this channel scope. These are self-reports, not verified teams or entrants. No complete-history or thread coverage is claimed.

snapshots.label: H-E-B earlier-message sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Twenty additional earlier messages were read, without a channel-start marker or complete-history claim. Five further posts supply labels in response to the participation prompt; the prompt's original message ID was not loaded. A separate team-name reply to a workspace/credits prompt is excluded from participation counts. Evaluation and submission guidance remains attributed to authors with unverified roles.

snapshots.label: Hitachi sample · Nov 8
snapshots.coverage_note: Ten message items were read, spanning displayed November 7–8. No channel-start marker, complete-history coverage or thread census was established. Attachment contents were not read or downloaded. Guidance about models and scoring is attributed to message authors with unverified roles.

reaction_summary.caveat: Only two inspected messages; events across emoji are not unique reactors or total dataset/channel reactions. No reaction growth/velocity supported.

privacy.display_alias_scope: Within challenge channel only; no cross-channel unique-person totals.
privacy.source_urls_and_ids_reidentification_cav: Message IDs and source links permit authorized server members to locate original content, including author names. This is a pseudonymized analytical derivative, not an irreversibly anonymous dataset.
privacy.reported_label_scope: H-E-B participation aliases scoped to heb-channel-20261108; eleven posts carry nine labels. These are not verified team/entrant counts.

source_distinctions.messages: Online UI observations collected by assistant; not in-person survey or fabricated fieldwork.
source_distinctions.synthetic: Separate synthetic-teams and team-challenges files: 9 fictional four-member teams and 21 fictional assignments. No real team contacts. Retain source_type synthetic, is_observed false, scenario_only true. Never append these to Messages.

eligibility_gaps: Written Build-A-Dataset guide requires primary physical-world collection; source files document online assistant observations only.
User-reported organizer remote-observation exception and exact scope are not independently verified.
Two displayed message dates are November 4, before the event; acquisition during the event does not make those posts newly created during the event.
No physical-world contacts, surveys, verified team memberships, entrant totals, submission outcomes or winning probabilities established.
Samples are nonrandom and bounded with unequal spans; no full channel/thread census or comparable observation window.
Exact acquisition times were not recorded; displayed posting timezone is unverified.
Single-assistant coding without independent human review or second-coder validation.
Catalog context may include null deadlines and explicitly recorded unknowns; it is not evidence that participant eligibility or submission requirements are satisfied.

documentation_findings.issue: display_label_message_counts definition says aliases A–E, but other channel aliases include prefixed labels and extend beyond E; describe general within-channel aliases.
largest_display_label_message_share definition says currently 6/10=0.6; this is the Rev sample example, not every channel.
category_counts definition says six exclusive categories; actual dataset contains twelve observed categories.

Includes historical blocked-navigation note that seven other channels were not acquired during that reread; current dataset later contains all eight channel samples. Retain as session history, not current global coverage.

excel_requirements: Messages sheet must have exactly 140 unique source rows, one per message_id; preserve all 30 original fields.
Write message_id, reply_to_message_id and all other identifiers as actual string cell values with text format; never numeric or scientific notation.
Use separate 11-row Snapshots and 150-row SnapshotMembership bridge sheets; snapshot membership must not inflate Messages to 150 rows.
Use separate eight-row Coverage and eight-row Challenges sheets; join only on challenge_id.
Preserve nested objects/arrays losslessly as JSON text columns, or normalize them to explicitly documented child sheets while retaining raw JSON.
Keep null/missing values blank and explain unknown vs zero; unknown posting timezone, capture times, participant/team/entrant counts and activity rates must stay unknown.
Preserve displayed posting date/time without manufacturing timezone, UTC timestamp or continuous interval.
Distinguish observed-message data, externally sourced catalog facts, and synthetic scenario sheets; synthetic data must never be blended into observed summaries.
Any category chart denominator is the selected message count, not people or teams.
Include source links and provenance, with note that original Discord URLs require authorized server access.

coverage.example: Largest within-channel display-label share of the inspected messages; not verified account or team concentration.

message_dictionary.message_id: Exact Discord message identifier. Primary key for one observed message; preserve as text because Excel numeric storage can round long IDs.
message_dictionary.challenge_id: Stable challenge key joining messages to the eight-row challenge catalog and channel coverage table.
message_dictionary.source_type: Acquisition class. All observed-message rows are discord_ui_observation; not a survey or physical-world observation.
message_dictionary.source_url: Exact Discord message URL retained for provenance. Resolves only for a user with source-server access and may reveal source authors to authorized readers.
message_dictionary.channel_url: Discord channel URL for the recorded message; source provenance, not proof of complete coverage.
message_dictionary.display_date: Calendar date displayed by Discord, stored YYYY-MM-DD. Posting/display date is distinct from collection date.
message_dictionary.display_time: Time displayed by Discord, HH:mm, with no verified timezone. Preserve as displayed text; do not create a UTC timestamp.
message_dictionary.timezone: Timezone of displayed posting timestamp; null for every current row because it was not verified.
message_dictionary.captured_at: Exact acquisition timestamp; null because a precise capture time was not recorded.
message_dictionary.display_alias: Pseudonymous rendered display-label alias scoped to its challenge channel. It does not identify a verified account, individual, or team.
message_dictionary.category: One exclusive assistant-assigned content category. Single-assistant interpretation, not independently validated.
message_dictionary.paraphrase: Neutral summary of observed content; not verbatim quotation and not independently verified evidence of claimed scores or outcomes.
message_dictionary.reply_to_message_id: Exact linked parent message ID when observed; text or null. Null does not imply no reply relationship exists.
message_dictionary.human_reviewed: Whether independent human review is recorded; false for all current rows.
message_dictionary.snapshot_ids: All known observation snapshots containing this message. These associations do not create additional message records.
message_dictionary.author_role: Verified role only where evidence exists. All current rows are unknown; do not assume participant-only data.
message_dictionary.role_evidence: Explicit evidence supporting an author role; all current rows null.
message_dictionary.reported_team_alias: Pseudonymous label explicitly self-reported in participation messages; not a verified team identifier.
message_dictionary.reported_team_alias_scope: Scope within which reported labels may be deduplicated; current non-null value is heb-channel-20261108.
message_dictionary.reaction_count_observed: Latest inspected total reaction events across emoji on this message. Known only for two messages (15 and 1); null is unmeasured.
message_dictionary.reaction_types_observed: Number of distinct emoji reaction types in the latest inspected reading. Integer values are 1 and 2; null means unmeasured. This is not an array or a unique-reactor count.
message_dictionary.reaction_observed_on_local: Local calendar date of the reaction reading, distinct from message display_date.
message_dictionary.reaction_observed_timezone: Timezone for the reaction observation date, not the posting timestamp.
message_dictionary.reaction_capture_time: Exact reaction-reading capture time if recorded; null for every row.
message_dictionary.reaction_snapshot_id: Snapshot in which the current reaction reading was observed. Do not backdate reaction values to earlier sightings.
message_dictionary.collector: Who collected the observation; assistant on all current rows.
message_dictionary.collection_method: Actual authorized UI acquisition method for the record.
message_dictionary.coding_method: Actual method used to assign the content category.
message_dictionary.identity_unit: Scope and limits of the alias identity unit.
message_dictionary.reaction_observation_note: Reading-specific explanation of reaction counts and limitations.

coverage_dictionary.challenge_id: Stable challenge key joining messages to the eight-row challenge catalog and channel coverage table.
coverage_dictionary.source_type: Acquisition class. All observed-message rows are discord_ui_observation; not a survey or physical-world observation.
coverage_dictionary.source_url_verification: How the channel source was verified.
coverage_dictionary.coverage_status: All current channels partial; not a census or verified full interval.
coverage_dictionary.coverage_note: What was inspected and relevant acquisition limitations. Some text preserves historical access limitations.
coverage_dictionary.captured_at: Exact acquisition timestamp; null because a precise capture time was not recorded.
coverage_dictionary.displayed_date: Readable single displayed date or date span, not an acquisition interval.
coverage_dictionary.first_displayed_time: Earliest displayed message time, paired with first_displayed_date.
coverage_dictionary.last_displayed_time: Latest displayed message time, paired with last_displayed_date.
coverage_dictionary.window_start: Start of a complete continuous observation window; null because no such window is established.
coverage_dictionary.window_end: End of a complete continuous observation window; null because no such window is established.
coverage_dictionary.timezone: Timezone of displayed posting timestamp; null for every current row because it was not verified.
coverage_dictionary.observed_messages: Distinct message IDs in this channel sample, deduplicated across snapshots.
coverage_dictionary.distinct_display_labels: Number of distinct within-channel display aliases; not verified people or teams.
coverage_dictionary.display_label_message_counts: Object mapping within-channel alias to message count.
coverage_dictionary.largest_display_label_message_share: Largest within-channel alias message count divided by observed_messages; not people/team concentration.
coverage_dictionary.concentration_note: Scope limitation for the alias concentration value.
coverage_dictionary.category_counts: Object of category counts reconciled with the channel message rows.
coverage_dictionary.team_count: Null; verified team population not measured.
coverage_dictionary.entrant_count: Null; eligible entrant population not measured.
coverage_dictionary.messages_per_hour: Null; no comparable complete observation interval.
coverage_dictionary.snapshot_ids: Observation-session keys associated with this channel.
coverage_dictionary.snapshot_count: Number of snapshots, including repeated sightings.
coverage_dictionary.reaction_counted_messages: Count of messages with inspected reactions; null in channels without reaction inspection.
coverage_dictionary.reaction_count_sum_observed: Sum of known latest reaction readings only; neither complete reactions nor unique reactors.
coverage_dictionary.first_displayed_date: Earliest displayed message date, paired with first_displayed_time.
coverage_dictionary.last_displayed_date: Latest displayed message date, paired with last_displayed_time.
coverage_dictionary.participation_report_messages: Count of participation_confirmation message posts within the sample; a zero is not absence of participation.
coverage_dictionary.reported_team_label_count: Distinct self-reported labels within an explicit channel scope; not verified teams.
coverage_dictionary.reported_team_alias_scope: Scope within which reported labels may be deduplicated; current non-null value is heb-channel-20261108.
coverage_dictionary.participation_coverage_note: Limitations of reported labels and participation-post interpretation.

snapshot_dictionary.snapshot_id: Unique observation-session identifier. Primary key for snapshots.
snapshot_dictionary.label: Human-readable observation-session label.
snapshot_dictionary.challenge_id: Stable challenge key joining messages to the eight-row challenge catalog and channel coverage table.
snapshot_dictionary.observed_on_local: Calendar date on which source material was read.
snapshot_dictionary.observation_timezone: Timezone for observed_on_local; America/Chicago, distinct from unknown displayed timezone.
snapshot_dictionary.captured_at: Exact acquisition timestamp; null because a precise capture time was not recorded.
snapshot_dictionary.message_ids: Exact observed message IDs within this snapshot. Normalize to a bridge table without duplicating the main Messages rows.
snapshot_dictionary.observed_messages: Number of message IDs within this snapshot. Summing across snapshots double-counts repeated sightings.
snapshot_dictionary.displayed_start: Nested date/time of first rendered message in this snapshot; timezone unverified.
snapshot_dictionary.displayed_end: Nested date/time of last rendered message in this snapshot; timezone unverified.
snapshot_dictionary.timezone: Timezone of displayed posting timestamp; null for every current row because it was not verified.
snapshot_dictionary.timezone_verified: False; displayed timezone was not independently verified.
snapshot_dictionary.coverage_note: Actual inspected scope, limitations, and relevant historical access status.
snapshot_dictionary.collection_method: Acquisition surface/method recorded for this observation session.
snapshot_dictionary.channel_start_seen: Whether a channel-start marker was seen; does not establish complete history or thread coverage.
snapshot_dictionary.channel_end_seen: Whether the end of channel content was seen; not by itself complete history.
snapshot_dictionary.threads_inspected: Whether thread content was inspected in the snapshot.
snapshot_dictionary.reaction_counted_message_ids: IDs of messages whose reactions were inspected in this observation session.
